name: The Land of Ghron: The Bear and the Gladiator
source:
"When he who slumbers finally awakes, then the world will finally know its true purpose for existing. And I cannot wait."

Following his crazy bout with his party member Rydel back in the city of Jenori'i, Erenok's arm guard has been falling apart at the seams. The party decides that the best course of action would be taking a stop at the most industrial city in the world: The Domed City of Hinden. While there, Erenok seems to get more than he bargained has he meets the blacksmith, and starts to feel emotions he's never felt before...

The Bear and the Gladiator is a short story set in The Land of Ghron universe, following the The Exalted Voyagers as they head to The Domed City of Hinden.

[From [url=https://blue1442.itch.io/bearandthegladiator]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
“当沉睡的人最终醒来时，世界将最终知道它存在的真正目的。而我已经等不及了。”

埃雷诺克在杰诺里市与他的党员里德尔发生疯狂的争吵后，他的护臂已经快要崩溃了。该党决定最好的行动方案是在世界上最工业化的城市停留：圆顶城市欣登。在那里，埃雷诺克遇到了铁匠，似乎得到了比他预想的更多的东西，并开始感受到他以前从未感受过的情感……

《熊与角斗士》是一部以戈隆之地宇宙为背景的短篇小说，讲述了尊贵航海者前往欣登穹顶之城的故事。

[来自[url=https://blue1442.itch.io/bearandthegladiator]Itch.io[/url]]
